articles.title: New York JFK Fuel Truck Damages Air China Boeing 747-8, Jet Fuel Pours From Wing
articles.summary: An Air China Boeing 747-8 has been left stranded at New York JFK Airport after it was damaged by a fuel truck during refueling. The truck reportedly pulled away from the aircraft while fuel hoses were still connected, damaging the wing refueling ports and sending jet fuel pouring onto the apron.
